title: My Face Msg
summary: A social networking platform with posts, groups, pages, comments, likes and an integrated marketplace experience.
challenge: The product required a broad set of social features while also supporting marketplace functionality within the same platform.
solution: Built server-side functionality in Core PHP and MySQL.
Implemented posts, groups, pages, comments and likes.
Extended the platform with marketplace functionality.
Worked across the application stack to support user-facing workflows and the underlying data model.
outcomes: Delivered a multi-feature social platform combining community and marketplace capabilities.
